subject: Money
title: Wage-Price Spiral
description: A short lesson to help you apply Wage-Price Spiral.

hook.text: Prices rise 5%, workers demand 5% raises, companies raise prices 5% more. The loop feeds itself.

buildup.text: A wage-price spiral happens when rising wages cause rising costs which cause rising prices which cause rising wages.

discovery.text: Once inflation expectations take hold, they become self-fulfilling. People raise prices because they expect others will.

twist.text: Breaking the spiral requires pain. Volcker raised rates to 20% in 1981, causing a brutal recession to kill inflation.

climax.text: Inflation expectations are more dangerous than inflation itself. Once people believe prices will rise, they will.

quiz.question: What is a wage-price spiral?
options: Rising wages and prices feeding each other
Government setting both wages and prices
